mapper.sql: select vr.id, vr.visitor_name, vr.visitor_phone, vr.visit_purpose, vr.dept_id, vr.appointment_time, vr.status, vr.check_in_time, vr.check_out_time, vr.remark, vr.create_by, vr.create_time, vr.update_by, vr.update_time, sd.dept_name from sys_visitor_registration vr left join sys_dept sd on sd.dept_id = vr.dept_id and sd.del_flag = '0' where vr.del_flag = '0'
